7C1DE9.confound_note: Every case measures cart additions, not purchases. 828C2F.confound_note: Every case measures units per order, not revenue per order. How many items go into a basket is not what the basket is worth: a repricing that lowers unit prices routinely lifts units per order while the money taken on each order holds flat or falls, and the two move in opposite directions whenever demand is elastic. The claim is about revenue per order, so none of the four lines, from 4 March at Harlow Street to 26 November at Tamsin Row, bears on it.

3313F1.confound_note: Every case measures planned route time, the duration the routing software assigns to a run before it leaves, not the delivery time recorded on the road. 036205.confound_note: Every case measures backpressure across the filter housing, not particulate at the stack outlet. The claim is about particulate readings, so the four measurements taken on 26 February, 28 May, 27 August and 25 November do not bear on it.

B3AE67.confound_note: Every one of the four cases reports tetrazolium viability, not germination. 49435F.confound_note: Every case measures mean void area inside the solder joints, which is not the rate of defective boards. The failure modes that decide whether a board is defective - opens, solder bridges, tombstoned parts and insufficient wetting - are not counted by a void-area measurement at all. The claim is about board defects, so none of the four runs speaks to it.
